evidence_mode: saved replay for owner review; no new scientific inference

families.changed: Increase a central circular lesion from radius 16 to radius 18.
families.label: Lesion basin
families.match_note: Same formed state and native seed-7 continuation stream; challenge amount differs by design.
families.observed: Radius 16 returns to the low-error regime; radius 18 stalls at substantially higher error.
families.prediction: Calibration map: characterize the tested central-lesion recovery boundary.
families.refuter: Not a directional preregistration; interpret only within the tested radii, state, geometry, and stochastic stream.
families.warranted: Recovery has a finite tested basin for this central-circle challenge family.

families.changed: Replace the 793-pixel radius-16 circle with an equal-area 4:1 ellipse aligned to target PC1.
families.label: G1 · Geometry
families.match_note: Equal 793-pixel masks; immediate target error and live-cell removal are closely matched.
families.not_established: Pure anatomical anisotropy or a universal shape law.
families.observed: The PC1 ellipse is worse than the circle in 4/4 confirmation streams despite closely matched immediate severity.
families.prediction: At matched removed pixel count, elongated lesions should recover better than the compact circle because a local CA has more intact boundary per removed cell from which corrective dynamics can propagate.
families.refuter: If both elongated orientations are consistently worse than the circle, reject the simple boundary-to-area explanation and treat shape/topological severing as load-bearing. A strong orientation split is evidence of anisotropy and must not be averaged away.
families.warranted: Geometry/orientation can move the recovery boundary beyond lesion pixel count; exposed boundary length alone is insufficient.

families.changed: Move the lesion from the target-derived centroid to the preregistered lower-annulus-support PC1-negative location while matching immediate target error.
families.label: L1 · Location / support
families.match_note: Immediate target error is matched within 5%; radii/areas differ, so geometry remains a caveat.
families.not_established: A universal annulus-support law or a geometry-free pure location effect.
families.observed: The lower-support location is worse in 4/4 future streams (mean target MSE 0.00477 vs 0.00299).
families.prediction: Among severity-matched target-derived locations, pc1_neg has lower intact live-cell support in the 3-pixel annulus (0.1043) than centroid (0.3052) and should therefore recover worse at 96 steps.
families.refuter: If pc1_neg is not worse than centroid in most matched future streams, reject local annulus live-cell support as a sufficient directional predictor of location-dependent recovery.
families.warranted: Where damage occurs and local intact-cell support can matter for recovery in this specimen.

families.changed: Apply the same radius-8 challenge at developmental step 48 rather than only after the mature step-96 state.
families.label: T1 · Developmental timing
families.match_note: Visual pair is same checkpoint/state history; cross-checkpoint summary uses the same radius-8 geometry and ~25% live-cell burden.
families.not_established: A monotonic younger-is-more-plastic rule or an isolated hidden-history effect.
families.observed: Step 48 is farther from its same-checkpoint control than step 96 in 4/4 streams; step 72 is mixed.

plot.title: Damage/control divergence by checkpoint
plot.y_label: mean RGB MSE vs matched control after 96

families.prediction: If ongoing developmental dynamics provide additional corrective routes, damage removing approximately 25% of currently live cells at steps 48 and 72 should recover at least as close to each checkpoint's matched undamaged branch as the corresponding mature step-96 damage.
families.refuter: If mature step-96 damage is consistently closer to its matched undamaged branch than both earlier checkpoints, reject the simple earlier-development-is-more-correctable prediction and treat competence as phase/state dependent in the opposite direction.
families.warranted: Regenerative performance depends on developmental state/timing.

families.changed: Preserve visible RGBA and the full multiset of 12-channel hidden vectors, but spatially reassign those hidden vectors inside the radius-16 region.
families.label: H2 · Latent consistency
families.match_note: Same formed state and future update stream; shuffle preserves visible RGBA and the hidden-vector multiset.
families.not_established: Memory, a semantic goal, or an explicit target map in the hidden channels.
families.observed: Hidden-vector shuffle is worse than full deletion in 4/4 streams (mean target MSE 0.06216 vs 0.00316).
families.prediction: If the hidden-zero result is driven by visible/latent inconsistency rather than merely loss of hidden content, spatially shuffling intact 12-channel hidden vectors among radius-16 cells should also be damaging and should be worse than full deletion in most matched streams.
families.refuter: If hidden-vector shuffle is close to undamaged while hidden-zero remains damaging, weaken the visible/latent inconsistency account and investigate zeroing or loss of specific hidden content instead.
families.warranted: Visible/latent spatial compatibility is causally load-bearing, not merely the presence of hidden values.

families.changed: Begin from identical radius-16 damage, then suppress updates only inside the original lesion footprint for the first 64 recovery steps.
families.label: A1 · Action availability
families.match_note: Initial damaged state and future RNG are identical; the gate changes action availability without overwriting state.
families.not_established: Formal unreachability or a theorem about all longer futures.
families.observed: Every blackout hurts; 64 steps is clearly worst. The strict 0<16<32<64 dose ordering is mixed, and divergence persists after release through +256.
families.prediction: With identical radius-16 damage, 96-step recovery error should worsen monotonically as updates inside the original lesion footprint are withheld for 0, 16, 32, or 64 steps.
families.refuter: If longer action blackouts do not produce a monotonic worsening in most matched future streams, reject blackout duration as a simple directional predictor in this regime. If 96-step differences substantially shrink after all actions are restored through step 256, interpret them primarily as time-budget/delay costs; persistent divergence motivates path-dependence analysis, not an automatic claim of formal unreachability.
families.warranted: Timely local action availability is load-bearing; temporary restriction can leave persistent path-dependent consequences over the tested horizon.
